KEY FACTS:
- Millennials are three times more likely to change jobs compared to predecessors.
- 90 percent of millennials change jobs within their first three years of employment.
- Millennials hold an average of four different jobs in their first ten years (by age 32).
- Data source is attributed to P. Murdock, "The New Reality of Employee Loyalty," Forbes, Dec 12, 2017.
